justification: Insufficient modularization is present. In `javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/javaparsermodel/declarations/JavaParserClassDeclaration.java` the class is 506 lines long and defines 30+ methods, spanning several concerns in one type: object identity (`equals/hashCode/toString`), field aggregation (`getAllFields`), method solving (`solveMethod`, `solveMethodAsUsage`), type/name queries (`getName`, `getPackageName`, `getClassName`, `getQualifiedName`), hierarchy/ancestor logic (`getSuperClass`, `getInterfaces`, `getAncestors`, `toReferenceType`), assignability checks (`isAssignableBy`, `canBeAssignedTo`), annotation/member access, and AST bridging (`getWrappedNode`, `toAst`). `javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/javaparsermodel/declarations/JavaParserTypeAdapter.java` shows some delegation, but the class still contains substantial resolver logic and duplication-like glue, indicating it could be split into smaller, more cohesive abstractions.
